_tile: The fourth Sunflowers, Arles, August 1888 -- the fifteen-flower version he hung in Gauguin's room. heads is the mass of seed-heads in the middle, which is the densest impasto in this piece; vase is the signed pot and the table line; ground is the flat yellow-on-yellow field at the top left, where the luminance ridge is blind and the chroma seeding of DESIGN 4.1 step 3 is doing all the work.
_px_per_cm: 84 px/cm delivered against 120 asked for, so this is resampled up by 1.43x. paintings/CREDITS.md already lists this canvas under Known gaps for exactly this reason and station 5 wants it enormous and close, which is the worst thing to want from a soft scan.
